editorial:
Imagine you are on a long road trip with your partner, just trying to get home, when you spot something truly gross in the back of a passing semi-truck. That is exactly how this ride starts. You follow a young couple who make the mistake of looking too closely at a truck driver's cargo. Suddenly, a normal drive turns into a scary game of cat and mouse. The vibe is very tense, making you feel like someone is always watching from the rearview mirror. It captures that scary feeling of being stuck on a highway with no way to escape a crazy person.

The action picks up quickly and keeps you on the edge of your seat. The acting is solid, and the way the tension builds makes the scares hit harder. While some parts feel a bit predictable, the fast pace makes up for it. If you love thrillers that make your heart race, you should definitely check this out. You can rent it on Apple TV for a quick movie night or grab the 4K Blu-ray if you want to add a physical copy to your collection for the best picture quality.
endingExplained: The movie ends with a final showdown between the couple and the killer truck driver. After a lot of chasing and fighting, the couple manages to fight back and stop him. They barely escape with their lives just as the nightmare ends. The twist is that the driver was far more dangerous and calculated than they first thought, but their quick thinking finally saves them from becoming his next victims.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves high-tension thrillers and road-trip horror movies.
